<!--
Thank you for contributing to Lychee-Mobile! Pull requests go to the main branch.

Describe the benefit to users and why it does not break existing features.

If you're pushing a Feature:
- Title it: "This new feature"
- Link its spec: docs/specs/4-architecture/features/<NNN>-<feature-name>/
- Describe what the new feature enables
- Add tests to test the new feature.
- Ensure it doesn't break any existing features.

If you're pushing a Fix:
- Title it: "Fixes the bug name"
- If it fixes an existing issue, start the description with `fixes #xxxx`.
- Describe how it fixes in a few words.
- Add a test that triggered the bug before fixing it.

CI runs `vp check`, `vp run typecheck`, `vp test`, the web build, an Android
debug build and an iOS simulator build. Run the first four locally before
pushing (see docs/specs/5-operations/quality-gate.md).
-->
